theorem actual_normalized_compact_clipped_observables
    {Ω : Type u} [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hh : Measurable (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2))
    (hh2 : MemLp (fun t : Ω × Ω => h t.1 t.2) 2 (μ.prod μ))
    (hhsymm : ∀ o y, h o y = h y o)
    (hcenter : (∫ t : Ω × Ω, h t.1 t.2 ∂(μ.prod μ)) = 0)
    (hprojectionsecond :
      (∫ o, (∫ y, h o y ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) = 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1)
    (C0 : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C0) :
    let g : Ω → ℝ := fun o => ∫ y, h o y ∂μ
    let r : Ω → Ω → ℝ := fun o y => h o y - g o - g y
    let v : ℝ := ∫ t : Ω × Ω, r t.1 t.2 ^ 2 ∂(μ.prod μ)
    let rho : ℝ := Real.sqrt v
    let N : ℝ := Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)
    let W : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := projectionW n g
    let V : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := projectionV n g
    let D : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := residualStatisticD n r
    let J : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := residualEnergyJ n r
    let Ddel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := residualStatisticDDeleted n r
    let Jdel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := residualEnergyJDeleted n r
    let A : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => |D ξ|
    let Adel : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => |Ddel ξ i|
    let B1 : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := studentizerClipBudget n r C0 rho 1
    let B1del : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := studentizerClipBudgetDeleted n r C0 rho 1
    let s2 : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := centeredSq n g r
    let s : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.sqrt (s2 ξ)
    let d : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := centeredDelta n g r
    let e : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := clippedCenteredDelta n g r C0 rho 1
    let Tclip : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := clippedCenteredStatistic n g r C0 rho 1
    let Tactual : (Fin n → Ω) → ℝ := fun ξ => if s ξ = 0 then 0 else (W ξ + D ξ) / s ξ
    let cap : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => min (|g (ξ i)| / N) (1 / (1 + z))
    let deletedTest : (Fin n → Ω) → Fin n → ℝ := fun ξ i => cap ξ i * (|A ξ - Adel ξ i| + z * |B1 ξ - B1del ξ i|)
    Measurable W ∧ Measurable V ∧ Measurable D ∧ Measurable J ∧
      Measurable A ∧ Measurable B1 ∧
      Measurable s2 ∧ Measurable s ∧ Measurable d ∧ Measurable e ∧
      Measurable Tclip ∧ Measurable Tactual ∧
      MeasurableSet {ξ : Fin n → Ω | V ξ = 0} ∧
      MeasurableSet {ξ : Fin n → Ω | s ξ = 0} ∧
      (∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + e ξ) ∧
      (∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω, V ξ = 0 →
        d ξ = 0 ∧ e ξ = 0 ∧ Tclip ξ = 0) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n,
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => cap ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Ddel ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Jdel ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => Adel ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => B1del ξ i) ∧
        Measurable (fun ξ : Fin n → Ω => deletedTest ξ i) ∧
        ∃ E : ({j : Fin n // j ≠ i} → Ω) → ℝ × ℝ × ℝ,
          Measurable E ∧
          ∀ ξ : Fin n → Ω,
            (Ddel ξ i, Jdel ξ i, B1del ξ i) =
              E (fun j : {j : Fin n // j ≠ i} => ξ j.val))

excerpt.source:
We only need the assumption `[Nonempty ι]` to prove `[Nonempty (α → β)]`. -/
theorem exists_measurable_piecewise {ι} [Countable ι] [Nonempty ι] (t : ι → Set α)
    (t_meas : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (t n)) (g : ι → α → β) (hg : ∀ n, Measurable (g n))
    (ht : Pairwise fun i j => EqOn (g i) (g j) (t i ∩ t j)) :
    ∃ f : α → β, Measurable f ∧ ∀ n, EqOn f (g n) (t n) := by
  inhabit ι
  set g' : (i : ι) → t i → β := fun i => g i ∘ (↑)
  -- see https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/issues/2184
  have ht' : ∀ (i j) (x : α) (hxi : x ∈ t i) (hxj : x ∈ t j), g' i ⟨x, hxi⟩ = g' j ⟨x, hxj⟩ := by
    intro i j x hxi hxj
    rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
    · rfl
    · exact ht hij ⟨hxi, hxj⟩
  set f : (⋃ i, t i) → β := iUnionLift t g' ht' _ Subset.rfl
  have hfm : Measurable f := measurable_iUnionLift _ _ t_meas
    (fun i => (hg i).comp measurable_subtype_coe)
  classical
    refine ⟨fun x => if hx : x ∈ ⋃ i, t i then f ⟨x, hx⟩ else g default x,
      hfm.dite ((hg default).comp measurable_subtype_coe) (.iUnion t_meas), fun i x hx => ?_⟩
    simp only [dite_eq_left (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hx⟩)]
    exact iUnionLift_of_mem ⟨x, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hx⟩⟩ hx

end Prod

section Pi

variable {X : δ → Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]

instance MeasurableSpace.pi [m : ∀ a, MeasurableSpace (X a)] : MeasurableSpace (∀ a, X a) :=
  ⨆ a, (m a).comap fun b => b a

variable [∀ a, MeasurableSpace (X a)] [MeasurableSpace γ]

theorem measurable_pi_iff {g : α → ∀ a, X a} : Measurable g ↔ ∀ a, Measurable fun x => g x a := by
  simp_rw [measurable_iff_comap_le, MeasurableSpace.pi, MeasurableSpace.comap_iSup,
    MeasurableSpace.comap_comp, Function.comp_def, iSup_le_iff]

@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_pi_apply (a : δ) : Measurable fun f : ∀ a, X a => f a :=
  measurable_pi_iff.1 measurable_id a

theorem MeasurableSpace.comap_le_comap_pi {g : (a : δ) → β → X a} (a : δ) :
    .comap (g a) inferInstance ≤ pi.comap (fun b c ↦ g c b) := by
  simpa only [pi, comap_iSup] using le_iSup_of_le a <| by measurability
